uñchati: uñchati [fr. uñch] to gather for sustenance, seek (alms), glean Vism 60 (= gavesati).
uññā: uññā (f.) [= avaññā (?) from ava + jñā, or after uññātabba? ] contempt Vin IV.241; Vbh 353 sq. (att°).
uññātabba: uññātabba (adj.) [grd. fr. ava + jñā (?)] to be despised, contemptible, only in stock--phrase "daharo na uṇṇātabbo na paribhotabbo" S I.69; Sn p. 93; SnA 424 (= na avajānitabbo, na nīcaṃ katvā jānitabbo ti). In same connection at J V.63 mā naṃ daharo [ti] uññāsi (v. l. maññāsi) apucchitvāna (v. l. ā°).
